A.notes: Site A delivers a highly polished, editorial interpretation of a technical tool. The typography and layout are pristine, elevating it above standard SaaS templates. However, it almost entirely ignores the motion requirement, relying on static layout rather than scroll-linked storytelling.

B.notes: Site B successfully uses scroll-linked motion to demonstrate the terminal working, directly addressing the brief's request. Unfortunately, it suffers from severe contrast issues (20 failing nodes) on body text and secondary elements, triggering a hard gate failure, and relies on a generic aesthetic.

raw.why: Site A is a masterclass in typographic craft and accessibility, easily winning despite its lack of motion, whereas Site B fails a critical accessibility hard gate.
